test_cases.title: User Registration — Valid Details
test_cases.subject: Registration
steps: Navigate to shop.shopsphere.com and click "Sign Up."
Enter a unique valid email, full name, and a password meeting complexity rules.
Click "Create Account."
test_cases.expected_result: Account is created, welcome email is sent via SendGrid, and the user is auto-logged-in and redirected to the homepage.

feature_context.description: Allow new customers to create an account using email/password or federated OAuth 2.0 login (Google, Facebook), and allow returning customers to authenticate securely.
pre_conditions: User has a valid, unused email address (for email/password registration) or an existing Google/Facebook account.
business_rules: Passwords must meet complexity rules
OAuth-created accounts do not require a password
duplicate emails are rejected at the database (unique constraint) and API validation layers.
exception_flows: If the email already exists, the system displays "An account with this email already exists" and offers a login link. If OAuth provider returns an error, the system displays a generic retry message and logs the failure.

test_cases.title: User Registration — Duplicate Email
test_cases.subject: Registration
steps: Navigate to Sign Up.
Enter an email address that already has an active account.
Submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the submission with the message "An account with this email already exists" and shows a link to the Login page.

test_cases.title: Product Search by Keyword
test_cases.subject: Catalog & Search
steps: Enter "running shoes" in the search bar.
Press Enter or click the search icon.
test_cases.expected_result: Relevant, in-stock products matching the keyword are returned within 300ms, ranked by relevance, with pagination of 24 items per page.

feature_context.description: Enable customers to browse the product catalog and search by keyword, with filtering by category, price range, brand, and rating, backed by an Elasticsearch index.
pre_conditions: Product catalog is indexed in Elasticsearch and synced from PostgreSQL via the nightly ETL job.
business_rules: Out-of-stock items are shown but ranked below in-stock items unless the user explicitly filters for in-stock only.
exception_flows: If zero results are found, the system displays "No products found" along with three related-category suggestions. If Elasticsearch is unavailable, the system falls back to a PostgreSQL LIKE-based search with a degraded-mode banner.

test_cases.title: Product Filter — Category & Price Range
test_cases.subject: Catalog & Search
steps: Perform a search or browse a category.
Apply the "Footwear" category filter.
Apply a price range filter of $50–$100.
test_cases.expected_result: Result set updates without a full page reload to show only in-stock Footwear items priced between $50 and $100, with updated facet counts.

test_cases.title: Add Product to Cart
test_cases.subject: Shopping Cart
steps: Open a product detail page for an in-stock item.
Select size/variant if applicable.
Click "Add to Cart."
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to the cart, the cart badge count increments, and a mini-cart confirmation drawer displays the item and updated subtotal.

feature_context.description: Provide a persistent cart that survives login/logout, device switches, and browser sessions, backed by Redis with PostgreSQL as the durable store.
pre_conditions: Product is in stock (quantity > 0) at the time it is added.
business_rules: Maximum 10 units per SKU per order
cart items are re-validated against live inventory at checkout initiation, not just at add-to-cart time.
exception_flows: If the requested quantity exceeds available stock, the system caps the quantity at the available stock and displays a warning. If a cart item goes out of stock before checkout, it is flagged in the cart with a "currently unavailable" label and excluded from the order total.

Increase the quantity of an item using the stepper control.
Observe the subtotal.
test_cases.expected_result: Quantity updates instantly, subtotal and tax estimate recalculate, and the change persists on page refresh.

test_cases.title: Apply Valid Coupon Code
test_cases.subject: Coupons & Discounts
steps: Proceed to the checkout review step with a cart total above the coupon's minimum threshold.
Enter the code "WELCOME10" and click "Apply."
test_cases.expected_result: A 10% discount is applied and itemized separately in the order summary, and the order total updates accordingly.

feature_context.description: Allow customers to apply promotional coupon codes at checkout, with validation of eligibility rules.
pre_conditions: A valid, active coupon code exists in the system.
business_rules: Only one coupon may be applied per order
coupons cannot be combined with each other but may combine with automatic promotions unless explicitly restricted.
exception_flows: If the code is invalid, expired, or the cart does not meet the minimum threshold, the system displays a specific inline error (e.g., "This code requires a minimum order of $50").

test_cases.title: Apply Expired Coupon Code
test_cases.subject: Coupons & Discounts
steps: Proceed to checkout review.
Enter a coupon code that expired in the past.
Click "Apply."
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the code with the message "This coupon has expired" and the order total remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Guest Checkout — Full Flow
test_cases.subject: Checkout
steps: Add an item to the cart without logging in.
Proceed to checkout and select "Checkout as Guest."
Enter shipping address, email, and phone.
Enter payment details and place the order.
test_cases.expected_result: Order is placed successfully without account creation, and an order-tracking link with a guest access token is emailed to the provided address.

feature_context.description: Provide a unified two-step checkout flow supporting guest checkout, saved addresses, and saved/new payment methods processed through Stripe.
pre_conditions: Cart contains at least one in-stock item with a valid shipping destination supported by the platform.
business_rules: All card data is tokenized client-side via Stripe.js — raw card numbers never touch ShopSphere servers (PCI-DSS SAQ-A scope). Guest checkout requires email and phone for order tracking.
exception_flows: If the card is declined, the system surfaces the Stripe decline reason (e.g., insufficient funds, expired card) and allows the user to retry with a different method without losing cart contents. If the PaymentIntent confirmation times out, the order is placed in "Payment Pending" status and reconciled via the Stripe webhook.

test_cases.subject: Checkout & Payment
steps: Proceed to checkout with a valid cart.
Enter shipping details and select a shipping method.
Enter Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with a valid future expiry and CVC.
Click "Place Order."
test_cases.expected_result: PaymentIntent is confirmed, order status is set to "Confirmed," inventory is decremented, and the user sees an order confirmation screen with the order number.

test_cases.title: Order Cancellation — Within Allowed Window
test_cases.subject: Order Management
steps: Open "My Orders" for an order still in "Confirmed" status.
Click "Cancel Order" and confirm.
Observe order status and refund.
test_cases.expected_result: Order status changes to "Cancelled," the Stripe authorization is reversed, inventory is restocked, and a cancellation confirmation is sent. [Note: Blocked — pending staging fix for refund-webhook timeout (JIRA SHOP-2291).]

feature_context.description: Allow customers to view order history, track real-time fulfillment status, cancel eligible orders, and initiate returns.
pre_conditions: At least one order exists for the customer or guest order-lookup token.
business_rules: Orders can only be cancelled prior to warehouse pick-pack confirmation
returns are only eligible within 30 days of delivery per the Returns Policy.
exception_flows: If the order has already moved to "Processing" or beyond, the Cancel action is disabled and a "Request Return" option is shown instead once the order reaches "Delivered."

test_cases.title: Real-Time Order Tracking Update
test_cases.subject: Order Management
steps: Open an order that has been marked "Shipped" by the carrier.
Navigate to the order tracking timeline.
test_cases.expected_result: Timeline reflects the latest carrier scan event (fetched from FedEx/UPS API, cached up to 15 minutes) with estimated delivery date.

test_cases.title: Add Product to Wishlist
test_cases.subject: Wishlist
steps: Log in as a registered customer.
Open a product detail page.
Click the heart / "Add to Wishlist" icon.
test_cases.expected_result: Product is saved to the user's wishlist, the icon reflects a filled/active state, and the item persists across sessions and devices.

feature_context.description: Allow registered customers to save products to a wishlist and submit star ratings with written reviews for purchased products.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated
for reviews, the user must have a delivered order containing the product.
business_rules: One review per customer per product
only verified purchasers may submit a review ("Verified Purchase" badge).
exception_flows: If the review fails the content filter, it is routed to a manual moderation queue rather than being auto-rejected outright.

test_cases.title: Submit Product Review & Rating
test_cases.subject: Reviews & Ratings
steps: Open order history for a delivered order.
Click "Write a Review" on a purchased item.
Select a star rating and enter review text.
Submit the review.
test_cases.expected_result: Review is accepted, passes the content filter, and updates the product's aggregate rating within a few seconds, tagged "Verified Purchase."

test_cases.title: Admin — Low-Stock Alert Trigger
test_cases.subject: Admin Portal — Inventory
steps: Adjust a SKU's stock down to below its configured reorder threshold (e.g., from 15 to 8, threshold 10).
Refresh the Admin inventory view.
test_cases.expected_result: The SKU is flagged "Low Stock" in the Admin inventory grid with a highlighted status badge.

feature_context.description: Enable Admin/Warehouse staff to manage stock levels, receive low-stock alerts, and reconcile inventory against incoming purchase orders.
pre_conditions: Admin user is authenticated with the "Inventory Manager" role.
business_rules: All manual adjustments require a reason code
low-stock threshold defaults to 10 units but is configurable per SKU.
exception_flows: If a stock adjustment would result in a negative quantity, the system blocks the change and displays a validation error.
